brief:
Palestinian children remain in Israeli military detention, according to Al Jazeera English. The report documents the practice of minors being held within the Israeli military justice system, raising concerns about their treatment and legal proceedings.

Details regarding the specific number of children detained, their ages, and the charges they face were not elaborated in the available material. The issue has drawn international attention regarding protections afforded to minors in conflict situations.
dek: Palestinian children in Israeli military detention…
title: Israeli military holds Palestinian children in detention
